name: Bru'kan
guide_text: Brukan's most common hero power is Lightning invocation, which is great to pop Divine Shields on your opponent's board.
buddy_guide_text: Buy this buddy for at most 3 gold, because it doesn't generate value. After you have it, try to double attack 1-2 times, deathrattles once if it doesn't grief your comp, and you still mainly press Lightning Invocation.
